subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw retroactively publish signed macOS desktop assets and `appcast-beta.xml` for `v2026.5.22-beta.1`, or record that this superseded beta has no macOS desktop build and focus on the future signed-beta gate?
rationale: The repository evidence shows the release is still missing the assets, but docs currently allow beta macOS omission and only maintainers with signing/notary/Sparkle release access can decide or execute the release path.

options.title: Do not retro-publish this beta
options.body: Document or confirm that this old beta has no macOS build, keep users on newer stable/beta releases, and land a future prevention gate if desired.

options.title: Retro-publish signed beta assets
options.body: Run the private macOS release workflow, upload signed ZIP/DMG artifacts, and publish a valid beta appcast for this exact prerelease.

options.title: Defer to the open gate PR
options.body: Keep this tracker open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 is reviewed and either merged, replaced, or closed with a release policy decision.

recommendation.title: Do not retro-publish this beta
recommendation.body: Document or confirm that this old beta has no macOS build, keep users on newer stable/beta releases, and land a future prevention gate if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The appcast history points to steipete as the strongest public appcast/release-promotion routing candidate for the specific publish-or-retire decision.
